en: A black‑and‑white panoramic photograph of a small town in a valley surrounded by mountains. The image shows rows of early 20th‑century multi‑story buildings, open fields, and winding roads, likely taken from an elevated viewpoint. At the top of the image, Italian text reads "Panorama di CAVALESE m. 1000", indicating a view of Cavalese at 1000 meters elevation.
